card.name: Verbs before a person's history or traits
card.fires_on: Linking or having words (is, has, whether, allergic, a) right after a person as subject, where a personal trait, history or preference comes next. Seen in allergy and prior-reaction screening lines and in short bios.

modes.label: Hypersensitivity inquiry
modes.description: The word 'whether' or 'HAS' after 'determine whether the patient' in the warning about previous hypersensitivity reactions.
modes.example: careful inquiry should be made to determine<< whether>> the patient has had previous hypersensitivity reactions

modes.label: Allergy history questions
modes.description: Words after 'you are' or 'screen patients regarding' that lead into allergies or past diagnoses.
modes.example: or if you are<< allergic>> to iodine.

modes.label: Personal bio statements
modes.description: Verbs or quantifiers after a named person that lead into traits or hobbies.
modes.example: Dr. Wrisberg enjoys<< several>> outdoor activities, including tennis, canoeing

card.writes: It pushes words about personal interests, likes and dislikes, mostly in Chinese and English.
card.plain: It fires on the word that introduces something a person has, is or likes, such as an allergy history or a hobby.
